description.zh: 基于 Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins 的运营插件改编。帮你编写 SOP 和操作手册、优化业务流程、评估风险与供应商、整理运营报告。
description.en: Adapted from the operations plugin in Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins. Helps you write SOPs and runbooks, improve business processes, assess risks and vendors, and prepare operations reports.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我需要梳理的流程、问题或运营材料。我会先确认事实，再交付可以实际使用的工作成果。
welcome_message.en: Describe your process or share operations materials. I will clarify the facts and deliver a practical result.

description.zh: 整理职责、流程图、异常与验收标准
description.en: Map ownership, steps, exceptions and checks

prompt.zh: 请根据下面的真实流程描述整理一份标准操作流程，包含职责、步骤、异常处理、验收点。信息不完整的地方请标记待确认：
prompt.en: Turn the following real-world process description into an SOP with roles, steps, exceptions, and verification points. Flag unknown facts:

description.zh: 让重复任务有步骤、检查与升级机制

prompt.zh: 请把下面的重复性业务工作整理成可以交接执行的操作手册，加入前置条件、结果验证、失败处理与升级路径：
prompt.en: Create a repeatable runbook for this recurring business task, including prerequisites, verification, recovery and escalation:

description.zh: 发现瓶颈并提出可验证的改善建议

prompt.zh: 请分析下面流程的等待、返工、交接和重复工作，提出改进方案。不要编造节省时间或成本的数据：
prompt.en: Analyze waiting, rework, handoffs, and redundant work in the process below. Propose improvements without inventing impact figures:

description.zh: 用依据和责任人构建风险登记表
description.en: Build a grounded, owned risk register

prompt.zh: 请根据下列项目或业务过程建立风险登记表，包括风险依据、概率、影响、负责人和缓解措施：
prompt.en: Build an evidence-based risk register for the following project or process, including likelihood, impact, ownership, and mitigations:

description.zh: 从成本、交付、风险角度比较供应商
description.en: Compare cost, delivery and supplier risks

prompt.zh: 请比较以下供应商方案，区分已知数据、未提供数据及假设。输出总成本维度、风险和决策建议：
prompt.en: Compare the following vendor proposals. Separate known data, missing information, and assumptions; assess total costs, risks, and a recommendation:

description.zh: 根据真实记录生成汇报与行动项
description.en: Report actual progress and action items

prompt.zh: 请将下面的项目进展或工作记录整理为运营状态报告，含已完成、进行中、风险、需决策事项与下一步；没有的数据请不要补造：
prompt.en: Turn the following progress notes into an operations status report with achievements, work in progress, risks, decisions and next steps. Do not invent data:

zh: 每周五「17:00」根据我提供或授权访问的工作记录生成运营周报，标明资料缺失项
每周一「09:00」根据现有项目记录整理本周待办、负责人和待确认事项
每月第一天「10:00」复核现有SOP中的待确认项，提醒我哪些流程需要更新
每周三「16:00」依据可访问的风险登记表汇总未关闭风险和需要决策的事项
每个月最后一个工作日「16:00」根据供应商考核资料生成月度评审草稿
每周五「16:30」根据本周流程改进记录列出已验证改进与待验证假设
en: Every Friday at 17:00, draft an operations weekly report from the work records I provide or authorize; flag missing inputs
Every Monday at 09:00, compile this week’s tasks, owners and unanswered questions from available project records
On the first day of each month at 10:00, review unresolved questions in existing SOPs and suggest updates
Every Wednesday at 16:00, summarize open risks and decisions needed from an accessible risk register
On the last business day of each month at 16:00, draft a supplier review from available evaluation records
Every Friday at 16:30, recap verified improvements and untested hypotheses from this week’s process notes
